'''Antar Bintaghr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Following the [[Battle of Rishi]], he was part of [[Satele Shan]]'s force that traveled to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and established the anti-[[Order of Revan|Revanite]] [[Yavin Coalition]] along with Imperial forces under [[Darth Marr]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Antar Bintaghr appeared as a Trooper gear vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]]. He was later removed during a gear system restructuring.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
